description: Chapter summaries the reader shows under a chapter's title, keyed by chapter number, per language. Like section headings they are editorial aids, not translation: written from Open Word Bible's own wording, stating what the chapter is about and nothing more, so every language can say the same thing. They use no reader settings. Every summary is an AI draft until a named reviewer approves it.

1.en: During a famine Elimelech and Naomi move to Moab, where their sons marry Moabite women, and then the three men die. Naomi returns to Bethlehem, and her daughter-in-law Ruth refuses to leave her: "Your people are now my people, and your God is now my God."

2.en: Ruth gleans in the field of Boaz, a relative of Elimelech, who treats her kindly because of her loyalty to Naomi. Naomi tells her that Boaz is one of their family redeemers.

3.en: At Naomi's urging Ruth goes to the threshing floor at night and asks Boaz to spread his cloak over her. Boaz promises to act as redeemer if a closer relative will not.

4.en: At the town gate the closer relative gives up his right, and Boaz buys Elimelech's land and marries Ruth. Their son Obed is the grandfather of David.
